title.narrative: Support and Empowerment of Augusta Victoria Hospital with Necessary Medicines and Medical Equipment

description.narrative: Contribute to reducing the number of deaths and critical cases; strengthen the capacity of health facilities in Jerusalem; provide emergency health services to beneficiaries among the sick, wounded and injured in Jerusalem.
Strengthen and empower the health sector in Jerusalem; reduce critical cases and deaths resulting from the unavailability of health services in Jerusalem.

Supporting and empowering the health sector in East Jerusalem, Palestine, by strengthening the capacity of Augusta Victoria Hospital with medical equipment and life-saving medicines that contribute to providing emergency health services to patient beneficiaries in Jerusalem.
Disbursement for "Support and Empowerment of Augusta Victoria Hospital with Necessary Medicines and Medical Equipment" in Palestine, implemented by Augusta Victoria Hospital
